evidence_and_mechanism: Total participants enrolled and randomized across 159 populated clusters (Control=970, Home visits=317, Afini=1174). Exactly verified from dataset.
Participants with final_status == 1 ('endline participated'). Published paper reports 2,183 endline surveys completed. Exactly verified from dataset.

Households not participating in endline survey: 10 child deaths (code 2), 100 moved away (code 3), 65 refusals (code 4), and 103 unreached after 4+ visits (code 5). Total attriters = 278 (2,461 - 2,183).

stage_quantity: Completed endline survey but unrecorded raw GSED score
evidence_and_mechanism: Twenty-nine participants have final_status == 1 but no recorded raw GSED score. The released dataset establishes that the score is absent; it does not establish whether the assessment was not administered or was administered but not recorded. This accounts exactly for the 29-case gap between completed surveys (2,183) and recorded raw GSED scores (2,154).

stage_quantity: Recorded raw GSED outcome scores in dataset
evidence_and_mechanism: Caregiver-child dyads with a valid recorded numerical endline GSED raw score (el_gsed_dscore notna). Exactly verified from dataset.

stage_quantity: Missing raw GSED outcome scores (Definition A: Primary Attrition)
evidence_and_mechanism: Sum of 278 pre-survey non-participants plus 29 survey-completed children without GSED assessment (278 + 29 = 307). Primary measure of outcome non-observation.

Children assessed for raw GSED but falling into 10-day age brackets with n=1 where sample standard deviation is undefined in Stata (brackets 73, 126, 131, 137, 146). These 5 children are technical outcome-construction exclusions, NOT participant attrition.
Participants with valid derived gsed_Z scores (2,154 raw GSED minus 5 singleton drops = 2,149). Exactly matches the primary analysis sample N reported in published Table 2.

stage_quantity: Standardized outcome unavailable (Definition B: Total Exclusions)
evidence_and_mechanism: Mutually exclusive sum: 307 missing raw GSED assessments + 5 singleton age-band technical drops = 312 total exclusions (2,461 - 312 = 2,149).

stage_quantity: Missing-outcome exclusions reported in paper text / Table 2 note
evidence_and_mechanism: The released data and local replication code account for 312 exclusions, while the paper footnote reports 332 exclusions. The cause of the 20-participant difference (332 - 312 = 20) is unknown with available sources. If 332 were excluded, the sample size would be 2,129 rather than 2,149.
